Alex M.: heads up — autotuner cache keying prototype landed on driver branch. need quick sync on persistence + invalidation strategy. :wave:
Priya S.: saw the PR, awesome. quick q: are we encoding kernel variant into the key?
Dan R.: yes — current proto uses model_id|model_sha|driver_version|kernel_hash|seqlen_bin
Meghan T.: that feels right, but will blow up cache during fast driver rollouts
Alex M.: agreed — thinking compaction + TTL. also want to persist hot entries to ssd across runtime restarts
Scott L.: what TTL are we considering?
Priya S.: profiling shows hot prefixes are reused within 2-10 minutes. p50 token latency improves ~8% when KV cache hits. propose default TTL 15m with adaptive extension on reuse
Dan R.: perf regression note: after adding kernel_hash into key we saw ~2% increase in miss rate during a canary -> rollout window (because kernel_hash changed). logs attached:
infra-bot: deploy: canary finished for driver v1.4.3 — 2/8 hosts reported increased kv-misses
Alex M.: suggestion: include 'compatibility_tag' that groups kernel variants with identical runtime ABI. fallback path keeps old key for N minutes after rollout.
Meghan T.: also need model reload invalidation. if model weights change but sha stays same (reupload), we should include model_epoch or model_sig. else we'll serve stale kv-level prefixes
Priya S.: agree. Proposed key format:
```
key = join("|", model_id, model_sig, driver_version, compat_tag, seqlen_bin)
```
where model_sig = model_sha + ":" + epoch
Dan R.: tests: added compaction job that scans for unused keys and deletes older than 1h or LRU beyond cap. microbench:
- baseline miss_rate 3.2%
- with kernel_hash key change miss_rate 5.4%
- after compat_tag grouping miss_rate 3.5%
Alex M.: nice. open questions: snapshot persistence strategy — snapshot to object store every 5m vs write-through on warm writes?
Scott L.: write-through is simpler but increases latency on writes. snapshot plus async apply gives better tail but risk of windowed loss
Meghan T.: we should instrument traffic splits — canary vs baseline — and auto-rollback if p95 latency delta > 10% or miss_rate > +2pt
Priya S.: can we add a flag to runtime to accept legacy_keys for X minutes to reduce churn? e.g., --kv-accept-legacy-ttl=900
Alex M.: yes, runtime flag + rollout orchestration with infra-bot hook. we also need to surface per-model cache stats in console
infra-bot: metric alert configured: kv.miss_rate.delta > 0.02 triggers pager in eng-runtime
Dan R.: I'll follow up with a small PR adding compat_tag generation logic and tests. will include benchmarks
Alex M.: thanks. let's do a canary tomorrow at 08:00 UTC. :eyes:
Meghan T.: +1
Priya S.: +1
Scott L.: thx
